fields.label: Four days around Khao Sok showed me how good it can feel to be present without a constant signal or
fields.default: Four days around Khao Sok showed me how good it can feel to be present without a constant signal or a packed schedule.

fields.label: The contrast with Bangkok was what stayed with me. In the city, there was always another place to go
fields.default: The contrast with Bangkok was what stayed with me. In the city, there was always another place to go or something asking for my attention. In Khao Sok, the days had a different rhythm: river tubing and a jungle walk, a boat out to the lake, kayaking and waterfalls. We spent a night by the water and got up early for sunrise before returning to the jungle for another night and a morning hike.

fields.label: For roughly half of that stay, there was no internet. I had expected that to make things less conven
fields.default: For roughly half of that stay, there was no internet. I had expected that to make things less convenient. Instead, it removed the habit of checking what was happening somewhere else. The people beside me and the place around us became the whole experience for a while.

fields.label: Looking back, I remember the activities, but I also remember the gaps between them: time on the wate
fields.default: Looking back, I remember the activities, but I also remember the gaps between them: time on the water, the change from the city and the feeling that I did not need to fill every moment. That is the part of Khao Sok I wanted to keep in this note. A beautiful landscape can be the reason you go somewhere; the way it changes your pace can be the reason it stays with you.
